_about: Public-domain John Stark Ravenscroft (1772-1830), first Episcopal Bishop of North Carolina, for the Word Hoard: his Works (2 vols., 1830: sermons, charges and his controversy with the Bible Society) and his separately printed sermons on the Church (1824), Revelation the Foundation of Faith (1829) and the consecration of Christ Church, Raleigh (1829). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 90 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
